statement: Full MSVC and UCRT64 validation runs on the self-hosted daily runner for schedules, manual dispatches and same-repository pull requests labelled windows-proof. Every admitted proof selects full native validation; aggregates reject drafts, missing draft metadata, unsuccessful classification and skipped expected producers. Normal CI retains its non-Windows jobs and base-retarget handling. Windows proof gates the v0.3.1 tag rather than landings.
